title: The Assignments CSV holds one row per customer with an assigned rep, sorted customer A→Z then rep A→Z; unassigned customers are excluded
custom_preconds: 1. The organization has several customers with assigned reps and at least one customer with NO assigned rep (seed as needed).
custom_steps:
1. Download the Sales Rep Assignments CSV.
2. Count the rows against the customers with assigned reps.
3. Search for the no-rep customer.
4. Read the row order.
custom_expected:
1. Every customer with an assigned sales rep produces exactly ONE row (single-rep model: one rep per customer).
2. Customers with no assigned rep are NOT included.
3. Rows are sorted by customer name A→Z (primary), then rep name A→Z (secondary).
